title: Measure the unmeasured cache protocol and deletion tactics (conditional)
acceptance_criteria: Arm A: compare version-validation-on-hit, a synchronous shared publication fence, and outbox-delivered invalidation under equal-total resources, coordinated writers; report database reads per logical read, wrong and impossible reads, stale duration, write and acknowledgement latency, contention, recovery lag

Arm B: pause an old filler across delete/recreate and tombstone expiry and audit resurrection with the independent operation ledger; compare a database soft delete, a hard delete and a cache tombstone
Every arm reports its negative controls and they must fire; a cell whose control does not fire is a failure, not a result
Correctness gates timing; one matrix at a time under the benchmark lock; no number is published without its same-run wrong-read and eviction/placement record
Placement distribution is recorded or the placement claim is reported as a gap
validation: HIGH protocol review before the matrix runs
HIGH review of the analyses against the run manifests
